tenderSchedule.title: Supply of Breakfast to Pourakarmikas/Loaders/Cleaners/Drivers/Driver cum Operator in Raichur City Corporation
tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Breakfast to Pourakarmikas/Loaders/Cleaners/Drivers/Driver cum Operator in Raichur City Corporation

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall strictly upload only the documents required under the tender conditions. No additional, irrelevant or unsolicited documents shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall have achieved an annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.209.24 lakh in at least two financial years during the financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26.The tenderer shall submit a year-wise financial turnover certificate duly certified by a practising Chartered Accountant, bearing the CA's signature, seal, membership number and valid Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN), along with supporting audited financial statements.The turnover shall relate to catering, hotel, restaurant, canteen or food-service business.The tenderer shall furnish a year-wise turnover certificate issued by a practising Chartered Accountant with valid UDIN, supported by relevant financial statements.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Be a legally registered Proprietorship/Partnership Firm/Company/Co-operative Society or other legally competent entity engaged in catering/food-service activities.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Possess valid PAN and GST registration.
Others -- Possess a valid FSSAI licence applicable to the proposed catering/food-service activity.
Others -- Not be under any subsisting blacklisting or debarment by any Government Department, ULB, PSU, statutory authority or Government institution.
Others -- Joint Venture tenders shall not be accepted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall have satisfactorily completed at least one similar contract having an executed value of not less than Rs.52.31 lakh during the financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26.Institutional catering, preparation and supply of breakfast/cooked meals, or operation of institutional canteen catering services. The tenderer shall furnish the corresponding Work Order/Agreement and satisfactory Completion/Performance Certificate issued by the competent authority of the concerned organisation, clearly indicating the nature of service, executed value and period of service. Merely operating a private hotel or restaurant, without having executed an institutional catering/supply contract, shall not by itself be treated as similar work experience.The experience shall be from any.Central/State Government Department, Urban Local Body, Government PSU/Undertaking, Statutory Authority, Government Autonomous Institution, or Other Government Institution.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Be a legally registered Proprietorship/Partnership Firm/Company/Co-operative Society or other legally competent entity engaged in catering/food-service activities.
